newsitem.title: USA: Enstar Group to repay creditors in full.
newsitem.headline: Enstar Group to repay creditors in full.

text.p: The Enstar Group Inc said Wednesday it has resolved all issues relating to its 1995 income tax returns, allowing it to repay creditors from its bankruptcy.
The company said it can now repay creditors in full with interest. Once its creditors are repaid, it will have a net worth of between $35 million and $40 million, the company said.
The company said it will now be in a position to reissue new stock to former shareholders of record on June 1, 1992, when its common stock was canceled because of bankruptcy.
